name: 90north-develop
description: North's development plugin: two loops on one discipline. workflow: the map — routes work to the right flow and holds the shared stages (isolate, review + QA, evidence video, ship, learn) and the Jira REST scripts. dev-loop: a story, task or spec from ready to reviewed PR — ready check, n-dev design note with a gate for Large or schema/interface changes, acceptance spec red first, work packages built test-first by dev-builder subagents, review + QA, inline demo video, 3-part Jira comment, review lane. defect-loop: sweeps the Jira defect board — triage, red e2e repro, root cause at path:line, test-first fix, review + QA, before/after videos inline, 3-part comment, QA lane. n-dev: how every change is written (design first, modular, reuse, extension files, one owner per fact, test-first, verified). Project facts live in each repo's .claude/90north-develop/, written by /90north-develop:develop-init.
